Class StructureEditor

java.lang.Object
io.github.wurtzitane.avogadro.api.StructureEditor
public final class StructureEditor extends Object
Edits a copy of a fragment, leaving the original unchanged.

Indices start at zero. Each operation uses the indices after the previous operation, so deleting atoms can change the indices used by later calls. build() returns the edited fragment and a mapping from the original indices to the new ones.

  • Method Details

    • replaceAtom

      public StructureEditor replaceAtom(int index, String element)
      Replaces an atom's element while preserving its coordinates, bonds, and attachments.

      Changing the element clears that atom's configuration override. Replacing it with the same element retains the override. Call atomConfiguration(int, AtomicConfiguration) afterward to assign a configuration for the new element.

      Parameters:
      index - the zero-based atom index
      element - the new element symbol, such as C or O
      Returns:
      this editor
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the index is out of bounds
